gen-dafont-dogica-gf-chivo: Chunky, wide-set and bossy, Dogica barks its headings with lowercase that nearly matches its capitals. Chivo follows with friendly sans-serif text whose curves keep visible daylight inside them, easing off the shouting.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-chocolate-classical: Chocolate Classical Sans is a sizable sans-serif with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut. And Dogica, heavy and widely tracked above it, gives that gentle text a firm, commanding doorway to walk through.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-comme: Comme runs smooth, its curves never clogging up. Dogica hits hard and wide above it, while the lowercase bodies below fill most of their height and keep the lines moving.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads wide and open on its small letters, with bodies that dominate the line and ascenders that barely show. Dogica supplies the muscle.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-fresca: Dogica is heavy and widely tracked, its lowercase rising nearly to capital height. Fresca replies with sans strokes that never thin or swell, so the openings stay connected to the space outside.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-funnel-sans: Blocky and loud, Dogica stretches wide with lowercase crowding its capitals. Funnel Sans steps in with a plain sans body of steady strokes and a wide-opened e, and that quiet, level manner is what stands out most.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-gafata: Contemporary in feel, Gafata stacks a tall band of letters under short stalks, each lowercase e looking wide-eyed and open. Dogica is built to hit hard; Gafata is built to be read.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-geist: Geist reads as a quiet, level beat, its words forming solid blocks rather than jagged skylines. Dogica, heavy and widely spaced, takes the loud role while Geist keeps the lines steady beneath it.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-georama: Lowercase that crowds right up to the capitals makes Dogica unmistakable. Georama gives it a plain sans partner with a bracelet-wide c and barely rising capitals, which softens the weight above.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-gidole: Dogica is heavy and wide-tracked, with curves that stay clearly open at their ends. Gidole counters with a plain sans of neon-tube consistency and terminals apart like scissor blades, and that uniform line is the pair's best trait.
